_comment: PRD-261 A-17b: recorded chat turns for the Play parity specs (specs/play-parity/), in the stream format lib/chat/hooks.ts reads: each frame is a '0:' text line ({ text }) or a 'd:' data line ({ data }), with the payload shapes the backend sends (a chat-id frame naming the new chat; tool-data with a tool_approval and a mission_approval, result_formatter.py; finish). A turn with hold: true keeps its stream open until the browser aborts it (Stop); a turn with a status answers that status with no stream (a refused request). support/play-chat.ts answers the app's own POST /api/chat with them, under builtin Play and under the installed package alike. Test data only.
